resources.string: Create a group or a broadcast channel with your contacts. Everyone you add must be one of your contacts with an encryption key.
You have no contact with an encryption key yet. Add one from Contacts first. You can still create an empty group and add people later.
Your device sent its MLS KeyPackage. The group owner must add it and return a Welcome before this device can send or receive group messages.
%1$s invited you to \"%2$s\". Nothing from this group is shown until you accept.
Every message is encrypted separately for each member with their one-to-one session. Members must be your contacts. Not MLS.
Legacy channel: only the owner and admins can post. Messages use separate one-to-one encryption.
Messages use MLS group encryption. Membership changes advance the group epoch and update its shared cryptographic state.
MLS broadcast channel: only the owner and admins can post. Messages use the shared group epoch.
Only the owner and admins can post in this channel.
You are no longer part of this group. Your copy of the messages stays on this device.
Group attachments require an MLS-enabled group.
The encrypted file could not be uploaded. Check your Blossom server and try again.
All your usable contacts are already in this group.
You are the owner. Make another member the owner before you leave.
You will stop receiving messages from this group.
You become an admin and the selected member becomes the owner.
The messages of this group are deleted from this device.
Not in your contacts: you cannot exchange messages with this member.
You do not have permission to do that in this group.
None of the members is a contact with an encryption key, so nothing was sent.
Every member must be one of your contacts with an encryption key.
This is not valid (empty name, nobody to add, or too many members).
Membership request sent to the group owner; it will apply after the owner processes it.
The OpenMLS native engine is not available in this build. MLS group operations are blocked rather than falling back to weaker encryption.
